title: The White Horse and the Final Victory
description: John sees heaven opened and a white horse with a rider called Faithful and True. His eyes are like a flame of fire, he wears many diadems, and he is clothed in a robe dipped in blood. His name is the Word of God, and on his robe it says King of kings and Lord of lords. The armies of heaven follow him on white horses. From his mouth comes a sharp sword that strikes down the nations. An angel calls the birds to the great supper of God. The beast and the false prophet are seized and thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur, while their armies are killed by the sword from the rider's mouth.
